Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 5 of 6; child 9 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement target/group/member selection modes for histogram bins, summaries, and other supported statistical outputs, with complete identity provenance or an explicit revision-aware resolver. Provide selected/total member counts and configurable any/all/fraction emphasis.

Acceptance criteria
1. Selecting a bin with 27 members returns exactly its 27 observation keys when exact membership is available; selecting the bin itself remains a distinct cheap operation.
2. Counts, representative rows, incomplete membership, and obsolete source revisions cannot be reported as complete selections.
3. Resolver results distinguish pending, unavailable, failed, and complete; late replies from obsolete plans are rejected.
4. Repeated/equal source rows and custom statistics are checked against explicit identity provenance and independent membership fixtures.
5. Linked scatter plots and histogram show partial-selection counts; filtering/recomputation is an explicit application action with its own result.

Exclusions
Inferring complete members from representative provenance or row equality; silently returning partial results as success.

Required evidence
Independent exact-member oracles, adversarial custom-stat/repeated-row fixtures, stale asynchronous-result traces, and SVG/Canvas analytical-example receipts.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B3FPJXKAYSYYF1DF7Q9M

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 09] Link statistical aggregates to exact contributing observations
